evidence_boundary: This is a revision-5 build/tool preflight contract, not a device simulation result. It preserves the prior recovery contract, the R01 Xyce build failure, the R02/R03 static contract failures and the R04 checker failure unchanged while passing explicit user-local BLAS/LAPACK paths and using token-safe candidate scope matching. A passing static contract report can establish only that the preflight chain is frozen and reviewable. Only a later passing build/tool preflight plus its independent persisted-evidence check can establish that a reproducible pure-source serial Xyce binary was built from the independently rehashed GPL source and that its scalar B-source self-test plus parser-only frozen IGZO candidate syntax check passed. The self-test is not an IGZO equation, device curve, physical parameter, experimental calibration, route comparison or circuit result. Proprietary binaries are excluded, and Xyce source/build evidence does not replace AIM-Spice Level 15 or HSPICE Level 61. M01 remains E0 until both formal device-only routes and an independent persisted-evidence check pass; P3, P5, C00, circuit, layout, PEX and HZO remain closed.
